children: Stock-specific action remained in focus on Dalal Street on September 22, with investors reacting to corporate developments and brokerages view.

Shares of Blue Star slipped 2 percent after Jefferies kept 'hold' rating with target price ₹1,635. The rising commodity costs and a weak rupee continue to pressure Q2 margins, while H2 margin recovery is expected from potential price hikes and cost-cutting measures. The September quarter has a weak base due to GST-led demand deferment last year. The brokerage expects Blue Star's data-centre business to contribute around 20% of sales by FY29, compared with around 10% in FY27. The stock trades at 47x 1-year forward PE, around 7% above its five-year historical average.

Reliable Data Services share price added 4 percent after board approved a proposal to raise funds of up to Rs 200 crore for various upcoming projects, the upgradation/expansion of existing projects, and enhancement of the company's working capital requirements.

Meesho share price jumped 5% after UBS kept 'buy' rating on Meesho and raised target price to ₹260. UBS has raised its FY29-31 NMV estimates by 7-18%, with contribution profit estimates increasing similarly, while EBITDA estimates have been raised by 20-40%.

Sansera Engineering share price advanced 6% after Goldman Sachs maintained 'buy' rating and raised target price to ₹4,990. Goldman Sachs said Applied Materials and LAM Research's announced investments of $5 billion and $1.2 billion, respectively, in India to build supplier ecosystems could be potential long-term growth contributors to Sansera Engineering's higher-margin ADS business. The brokerage remains positive in the context of Sansera's $180 million semiconductor order win from an existing customer and has raised its FY29 EPS estimates to partially capture the potential upside from the development.
On the sectoral front, the IT index declined nearly 1%, while realty indices rose around 0.6%.
The broader market were trading higher, with the Nifty Midcap 100 index added 0.3%, while the Nifty Smallcap 100 index rose 0.25%.
Market breadth on the BSE was positive, with 2171 shares advancing, 1258 declining and 188 unchanged.

title: Price Action: Meesho, Sansera Engineering gain 5-6% as brokerages retain 'buy' rating
